card.name: Single letters as labels
card.fires_on: A lone letter used as a label, such as a figure letter after the word Figure, or a footnote letter after a table entry. It also fires on the first letter of a name such as Luer-Lok.

modes.label: Figure letters
modes.description: A capital letter naming a figure in instructions for use or a figure list.
modes.example: The syringe is now ready for the injection (see Figure<< O>> ) .

modes.label: Table footnote letters
modes.description: A small letter attached to a table row or value as a footnote marker.

modes.label: Letter starting a term
modes.description: A capital letter that begins a hyphenated device name in parentheses.
